title: RoboPoint: A Vision-Language Model for Spatial Affordance Prediction in Robotics
summary: A vision-language model that answers language instructions with spatially actionable image keypoints for robotics.

mechanisms.name: Instruction-to-action keypoint prediction
mechanisms.description: Represents a requested action as one or more image points on the region where the action should occur, rather than a whole-object box.
mechanisms.limitations: Image-point accuracy does not guarantee depth validity, reachability, collision clearance, exact-instance identity, or successful action execution.
